description:
Can you turn a conference lanyard into a working digital camera? Using a DIY ESP32 microcontroller and mini camera module built by GitHub VP of DevRel Martin Woodward, we put the hackable GitHub Universe badge to the test on the event floor. Watch how the camera pairs over Bluetooth, spins up its own Wi-Fi network to stream a live preview, and turns the badge into a wireless viewfinder. The image quality might not rival a smartphone, but capturing event photos straight from your badge hardware is a fun maker hack.

More code. More vulnerabilities. Faster exploits. Is AI creating a cybersecurity crisis, or giving defenders the advantage? At GitHub Universe 2026, GitHub's Marcelo Oliveira and Latio's James Berthoty unpack the AI "vulnpocalypse" and discuss how AI-powered security can help organizations prevent, detect, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities at scale. Explore how AI SAST, push-time secret detection, Dependabot reachability, and agentic autofix equip security teams for modern threats. 
 
Learn more: https://github.com/security/advanced-security 

About the Speakers:

James Berthoty is the Founder and CEO of Latio, an independent cybersecurity analyst firm focused on helping security practitioners navigate the evolving security landscape through hands-on research, product evaluations, and industry insights.
